notes: T0258 idempotency conformance fixture. Receipts, logs and ledgers were computed at authoring time from the T0257 contract-derived reference engine (tests/test_t0257_idempotency_contract.py) over the linked WAL and rollback references. Malformed rows are discriminating: repairing only the declared locus makes each row valid. Rollback rows prove a rejected apply leaves the supplied log, ledger and request bit-identical before the valid follow-up.
